Sinestro Corps

Lyssa Drak

The Sinestro Corps’ lorekeeper.

Lyssa Drak is the Sinestro Corps’ lorekeeper, giving fear a history as well as an army. Her changing relationship with Sinestro makes her more than a permanently obedient chronicler.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Sinestro Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern (2005) #18 (2007), backup story
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Lyssa’s association with the Corps’ books places her near its mythology and secrets. Untold Tales of Blackest Night uses her to guide readers through the Book of the Black. Sinestro #1 (2014) brings her to the isolated former leader with information about Korugar’s survivors. The publisher describes her as both former ally and former enemy; absolute claims about lifelong loyalty obscure that role.

Key Stories

  • Sinestro
    Issue #1 (2014) begins the ongoing series
